the absence of malrotation (Johns Hopkins Medicine, 2022). 
Malrotations alone are usually asymptomatic. It is not until volvulus develops that a client experiences symptoms 
(Johns Hopkins Medicine, 2022) such as sudden and severe nausea and vomiting, dark red or bloody stools, severe 
constipation or difficulty expelling stools, abdominal distention, bilious vomiting (vomiting that contains bile), and 
shock.
